kultivator.tempat_ekonomi.senjata.bukan_: City weapon: can never become a Natal Treasure.
kultivator.tempat_ekonomi.senjata.jian.d: A straight double-edged sword, balanced in the hand. The weapon of scholars and wanderers.
kultivator.tempat_ekonomi.senjata.jian.i: Inspired by the jian, the Chinese straight sword called "the gentleman of weapons"; game design.
kultivator.tempat_ekonomi.senjata.dao.de: A single-edged sabre with a thick spine; its cuts are heavy and sure.
kultivator.tempat_ekonomi.senjata.dao.in: Inspired by the dao, the Chinese sabre called "the general of weapons"; game design.
A long-hafted spear with a red tassel; it reaches farther than a sword.
Inspired by the qiang, the Chinese spear called "the king of weapons"; game design.
A broad-bladed war axe; slow to swing, deep in the wound.
Inspired by the war axe (fu) of palace guards and the heroes of the Water Margin; game design.
kultivator.tempat_ekonomi.senjata.gada.d: A segmented iron mace; it does not cut, it crushes armour and bone.
kultivator.tempat_ekonomi.senjata.gada.i: Inspired by the segmented iron mace (square jian) and bronze maces of Chinese soldiers; game design.
kultivator.tempat_ekonomi.senjata.kipas_: A fan with steel ribs; light, fast and deceiving the foe's eye.
Inspired by the iron fan (tieshan) of martial heroes in wuxia tales; game design.
A hermit's horsehair whisk; soft, yet every flick carries qi.
Inspired by the fuchen, the whisk of Taoist priests and hermits in paintings and opera; game design.

kultivator.misi.buru.cerita.0: A raging spirit beast mauls the livestock in the fields near town. The farmers have not dared go out for three days. The guild pays whoever brings it down.
kultivator.misi.buru.cerita.1: A woodcutter came home with his clothes torn: something with red eyes lives in the eastern forest. It has already attacked two timber carts. Hunt it before somebody dies.
kultivator.misi.buru.cerita.2: A hide merchant posted a bounty on an old spirit beast guarding the hill path. Its skin is hard as armour; many hunters came back empty-handed.
kultivator.misi.buru.cerita.3: A herd boy swears he saw a silver-striped tiger drag a buffalo into the brush. Tonight every pen is double-locked, but a bamboo fence will not stop a spirit beast.
kultivator.misi.buru.cerita.4: Granny Liu the bun seller lost her donkey on the market road. The claw marks are as wide as a grown man's palm. The morning market has stood empty since; bring the beast down so the stalls open again.
kultivator.misi.kemah.cerita.0: Bandits camp by the road and squeeze every passing merchant. The post master asks the guild to clear them before the harvest caravans come.
kultivator.misi.kemah.cerita.1: Campfire smoke rises every night, seen from the watchtower. Scouts counted a dozen armed bandits. Clear that camp.
kultivator.misi.kemah.cerita.2: A village girl was taken to the bandit camp beyond the hill. Her family pooled all their savings for this bounty.
kultivator.misi.kemah.cerita.3: These bandits were once border guards dismissed without pay. Now they collect a 'road tax' with their own service swords. The guild does not care for their story; the road must be safe.
kultivator.misi.kemah.cerita.4: The teahouse's wine cart was robbed two nights running. The owner followed the wheel tracks to a campfire in the valley and saw his jars being emptied at a feast.
kultivator.misi.kemah.tahap.0: Defeat every bandit in the camp (%s).
kultivator.misi.herba.cerita.0: The healers' hall ran out of aged spirit herbs for a life-saving brew. Bring one herb old enough, any kind.
kultivator.misi.herba.cerita.1: A guild alchemist is refining a breakthrough pill. He needs a spirit herb old enough and pays well.
kultivator.misi.herba.cerita.2: The village head is gravely ill; the healer says only an old spirit herb can save him. There is little time.
kultivator.misi.herba.cerita.3: The Alchemist Guild's pill kitchen has an order from the palace: a longevity draught for an old minister's birthday. Every old herb in the store room is already gone.
kultivator.misi.herba.cerita.4: A fever is creeping from village to village along the river. A wandering healer boils old spirit herbs in a great cauldron to hand out; one more herb could save a whole hamlet.
kultivator.misi.herba.tahap.0: Bring one old enough spirit herb to the guild (%s).
kultivator.misi.herba.tahap.1: Hand the herb in at the guild.
kultivator.misi.kawal.cerita.0: A cloth merchant must reach the next town before the market opens. The roads are unsafe; he asks the guild for an escort.
kultivator.misi.kawal.cerita.1: A medicine trader carries a chest of costly herbs. Two of his guards fled after seeing wolf tracks. Keep him safe to the end.
kultivator.misi.kawal.cerita.2: A young merchant trades alone for the first time. His father pays the guild to bring his son safely to the next town.
kultivator.misi.kawal.cerita.3: An old fan maker carries an order of iron fans for the gate guards of the next town. He was robbed on the same road last year and his hands still shake whenever he sees a bush.
kultivator.misi.kawal.cerita.4: A tea merchant from the south carries the first harvest of purple cloud tea. It is worth its weight in gold, and every bandit in the region knows when the harvest comes in.
kultivator.misi.kawal.tahap.0: Bring the merchant safely to his destination (%s).
kultivator.misi.binatang.cerita.0: The beast den cave in the north breeds ever larger creatures. Its lord must fall before the pack comes down to the villages.
kultivator.misi.binatang.cerita.1: The miners hear roaring from below. A spirit beast den has opened a tunnel into their mine.
kultivator.misi.binatang.cerita.2: A mountain sect wrote to the guild: the brood mother in that den has already swallowed two of their disciples.
kultivator.misi.binatang.cerita.3: An old spirit bear rules the den behind the waterfall. Hunters call it Stoneback; three sect arrows still stand in its shoulder and it does not feel them.
kultivator.misi.binatang.cerita.4: Gu Lianshan of the palace treasury has done the sums: the pack from that den eats livestock worth three months of taxes from three villages. He would rather pay the guild once than lose those taxes for good.
kultivator.misi.binatang.tahap.0: Enter the den and defeat its lord (%s).
kultivator.misi.binatang.tahap.1: Return to the guild with proof (%s).
kultivator.misi.sarang.cerita.0: Demonic cultivators hide in a cave and abduct people for blood rites. Free the captives and break their lair.
kultivator.misi.sarang.cerita.1: A demon lair lies under the ruins of an old temple. The people around it vanish one by one every full moon.
kultivator.misi.sarang.cerita.2: An envoy of a righteous sect lost track of two disciples who went to probe a cave in the valley. They are thought to be prisoners of demonic cultivators.
kultivator.misi.sarang.cerita.3: A wandering monk came to the guild in a scorched robe. He saw a bone altar in a cave and black candles that never go out. He begs that the place be cleansed before the full moon.
kultivator.misi.sarang.cerita.4: A boatman found an empty skiff full of chains on the river. Wet footprints lead to a cave in the cliff. People whisper of demonic cultivators who sell captives across the water.
kultivator.misi.sarang.tahap.0: Storm the demon lair and defeat its keepers (%s).
kultivator.misi.begal.cerita.0: Highwaymen stop caravans on the main road and seize their loads. The waystation was looted twice this month.
kultivator.misi.begal.cerita.1: A guild courier was beaten and robbed of his letters at a bend of the road. The highwaymen camp close by.
kultivator.misi.begal.cerita.2: A salt merchant offers a big reward: a highwaymen camp by the road holds three of his salt carts.
kultivator.misi.begal.cerita.3: These highwaymen wear wooden masks of the mountain god and only strike when the fog comes down. The carters now refuse to leave before the sun is high.
kultivator.misi.begal.cerita.4: Madam Qian Duoduo of the Money House lost ten chests of incense pawned to her, seized on the road before they reached her vault. She promises the guild double pay if the highwaymen are broken up before the Moon Market.
kultivator.misi.begal.tahap.0: Go to the highwaymen camp by the road (%s).
kultivator.misi.kafilah.cerita.0: A trade caravan is leaving for another town. Highwaymen lurk midway; the caravan master needs an escort for the whole road.
kultivator.misi.kafilah.cerita.1: The salt and cloth carts leave this morning. Stay close to the caravan; it will not move without its escort.
kultivator.misi.kafilah.cerita.2: The caravan carries tribute for the capital. If it is lost on the road, the guild's name is tarnished too.
kultivator.misi.kafilah.cerita.3: The caravan master, Uncle Ma, has been on the road thirty years and never lost a single cart. This year his leg is lame and he needs an extra pair of eyes at the head of the line.
kultivator.misi.kafilah.cerita.4: This caravan carries a merchant's daughter's dowry to the groom's town. If even one chest goes missing the wedding may be called off and two families made enemies.
kultivator.misi.kafilah.tahap.0: Stay within 48 blocks of the caravan until it arrives (%s).
kultivator.misi.kafilah.tahap.1: The caravan arrived. Return to the guild.
kultivator.misi.gua.cerita.0: Hunters found a cave mouth that is on no map. The guild wants to know what lies inside; bring proof from its deepest chest.
kultivator.misi.gua.cerita.1: A strange light shows from a crack in the cliff at the new moon. Explore the cave and bring back something from inside.
kultivator.misi.gua.cerita.2: A scholar wrote of an ancient cave in this region. The guild buys proof that it truly exists.
kultivator.misi.gua.cerita.3: The Record Office found an old map with a cave struck out in red ink and the words 'do not open'. The clerk is too curious to let it be, but too timid to go alone.
kultivator.misi.gua.cerita.4: The village dogs howl toward the hill every midnight. A child went missing for a day and a night and came home with a glowing stone he says he took from a chest inside a cave.
kultivator.misi.gua.tahap.0: Enter the cave and bring something from a chest inside (%s).
kultivator.misi.gua.tahap.1: Hand the proof in at the guild.
kultivator.misi.kurir.cerita.0: A wax-sealed letter must reach the village beyond the hill. Its recipient waits for important news.
kultivator.misi.kurir.cerita.1: The market master sends a letter to the neighbouring sect compound. It is secret; do not open it on the road.
kultivator.misi.kurir.cerita.2: A mother entrusts a letter for her son, now a sect disciple. She has not heard from him in a long time.
kultivator.misi.kurir.cerita.3: The town healer wrote a prescription for a sick child in the village across the river. The handwriting is bad, but it can save a life; do not let the rain soak it.
kultivator.misi.kurir.cerita.4: A shy young man entrusts a love letter for the weaver girl in the next village, with a pressed flower inside. He pays with all his pocket money.
kultivator.misi.kurir.tahap.0: Deliver the letter to its recipient (%s).
kultivator.misi.kurir.tahap.1: Bring the reply to the guild.
kultivator.misi.tawanan.cerita.0: A captive freed from a demon lair is still terrified. Escort him safely home to his town.
kultivator.misi.tawanan.cerita.1: A farmer who escaped a bandit camp cannot find his way home. Take him to the nearest town.
kultivator.misi.tawanan.cerita.2: A youth sold at the Black Market escaped. His family in the next town waits in fear.
kultivator.misi.tawanan.cerita.3: An old scribe was freed from a bandit camp after a year of forging travel papers for them. He only wants to go home and drink tea on his porch again.
kultivator.misi.tawanan.cerita.4: A dancer from an opera troupe was kidnapped to be sold at the Black Market. Her troupe waits in the next town and has postponed the show until she returns.
kultivator.misi.tawanan.tahap.0: Bring the captive safely to the destination (%s).
kultivator.misi.naga_muda.cerita.0: A young master on the Young Dragon list challenges anyone who dares. Defeat him in a Sword Duel.
kultivator.misi.naga_muda.cerita.1: A challenger from a great sect wants to climb the list by beating newcomers. Show you are no stepping stone.
kultivator.misi.naga_muda.cerita.2: The guild arranges a friendly bout for the Young Dragon list. Many eyes will watch.
kultivator.misi.naga_muda.cerita.3: Feng Ao laughed at your name in the teahouse and bet that no newcomer lasts three moves against him. The guild has the arena ready; the gamblers have already placed their wagers.
kultivator.misi.naga_muda.cerita.4: A sect master's daughter wants to prove she is more than her father's child. She chose an opponent from the guild board blindfolded, and her finger stopped on your name.
kultivator.misi.naga_muda.tahap.0: Beat the challenger in a Sword Duel (%s).
Inside the den the brood mother stands over three cubs that cannot hunt yet.
Let them be (half reward, Nama Baik +3)

The highwaymen turn out to be farmers starving after a failed harvest. Their children wait in the camp.
Spare them and give them 20 NB

The seal cracked on the way: the letter is a duel-to-the-death challenge for its recipient.
